results.summary: Stage 0 Read for Contagion. record.json carries 83 inventory capabilities (79 built, 4 absent: pre-Burn Dive, Bodyprints, Rawshade, Zhool'Iza), taken over from the Codex dry pass of 2026-11-09 and re-checked against src (one Contagion commit since, 9fe1f933f0); all 29 built-evidence lines are accounted for in built_reviewed. Scope and decisions hold his words with sources: admission 2026-11-15, the 2026-11-10 card (weather and body lead; one dash at a cost; other useful tissue), mulch plain fertilizer, Dive and Bodyprints kept in, geometry-only sun, peaks look-only. Ten contradictions are open, three of them new: Bloom-time sun escape against his geometry ruling, the Coalescence stuck at Stage 1, and seven fix items still open that the source read describes as built. Three failure modes: the sky clock is not a decision, the body bargain collapses, green by counters but empty in play. Stage 1 opens with a draft live-walk proposal on the saved Contagion site (a_live_walk) before any design question; the Codex questions q01, q03 and q06 are answered and q02, q04, q05, q07 and q08 stay draft.
